description: Search locations (countries, metro areas / DMAs, US states and cities) using searchText input (required) and get their Levels.fyi slugs. Use this to resolve a location name (e.g. "San Francisco", "United States") into the slug the benchmark tools require in their locationSlugs filter. Each result includes its location type. Optionally restrict to one type. Results can include cities; pass a city's own slug to the pay tools. When a tool says a city has too little data, pass its parent location instead (a metro, or the country where there is none). Search by place name alone: "Cambridge", not "Cambridge, MA". Several places can share a name: pick the one the user means from context, and ask if unsure. If this returns no matches, fall back to search-all, which searches every entity type and applies a fuzzy fallback. REQUIRED arguments: searchText.

searchText.description: Location name to search for (country, metro area / DMA, or US state).

type.description: Restrict results to one location type. Omit to search countries, metros (DMAs) and states together, with matching cities after them.

name: search-locations
